title: How Can One Person Make a Positive Difference?
sum: One person can make a positive difference through small acts: helping a neighbour, passing on what you know, caring for shared places.

title: How Much of Ourselves Are We Not Aware Of?
sum: How much of ourselves are we not aware of? No one can give a figure, but some part is always out of view, and surprising reactions point to it.
img: the quote article's own signed image, its download JPEG (wp-content/uploads/quote-cards/og-quote--how-much-of-ourselves-are-we-not-aware-of--*.jpg)

title: On the Tranquility of Mind: Summary and Key Ideas
sum: Seneca's 2,000-year-old letter of advice to a restless friend on why a settled mind depends on what you hold onto, not on what happens to you.

title: The Elephant and the Rope Workbook: Free Worksheet
sum: Learn the teaching story of the elephant and the rope, then check one limit you still obey against what is true today.

title: What Is Self-Understanding, and Why Does It Matter So Much?
sum: What is self-understanding? See what there is to understand about yourself, where your picture of yourself came from and why it matters.

title: What Is Virtue in Simple Words?
sum: What is virtue in simple words? A quality of character you grow by practice that lets you live well and be good for the people around you.
quote: A virtue is simply a trait of character that enables a person to flourish.
img: the quote article's own signed image, its download JPEG (wp-content/uploads/quote-cards/og-quote--what-is-virtue-in-simple-words--*.jpg)

title: Originals: Summary and Key Ideas
sum: Adam Grant's research on how ordinary people generate original ideas, then manage the risk of championing them against the crowd.

title: Living Consciously, Not on Autopilot Workbook
sum: Learn the difference between conscious awareness and autopilot, then look closely at one recent reaction of yours and what was running it.

title: How Do You Keep Going When You’ve Lost Motivation?
sum: When you have lost motivation, you keep going by using what you already have: your time, knowledge and understanding. A mentor shares Achology.com's view.

title: How Do You Stop Living in the Past and Move Forward?
sum: How do you stop living in the past and move forward? Find what still ties you to it, loosen one knot at a time, and take the next step.
quote: We can’t move forward when we’re still bound to the past.
img: the quote article's own signed image, its download JPEG (wp-content/uploads/quote-cards/og-quote--how-do-you-stop-living-in-the-past-and-move-forward--*.jpg)

title: The Quick and Easy Way to Effective Speaking: Summary and Key Ideas
sum: Dale Carnegie's practical course in speaking with confidence, built from decades of teaching adults to talk without fear.

title: Morris Massey’s Values Development Workbook: Free Worksheet
sum: Learn Morris Massey's three periods of values development, then take one value of yours back through each and decide whether to keep it.

title: Can Self-Awareness Be Learned, and How Do You Develop It?
sum: Can self-awareness be learned? Yes: Achology teaches it as looking inward, in layers, across a lifetime. Questions to ask yourself.

title: Why Do We Remember Some Things and Forget Others?
sum: We remember some things and forget others because memory keeps what means something to us, and lets most of what we paid no attention to slip away.
quote: We only remember those things in life that mean something to us.
img: the quote article's own signed image, its download JPEG (wp-content/uploads/quote-cards/og-quote--why-do-we-remember-some-things-and-forget-others--*.jpg)

title: Meditations for Mortals: Summary and Key Ideas
sum: Oliver Burkeman's twenty-eight meditations on embracing your limits and finding what actually counts in an unsorted life.

title: The Discipline of Mindful Listening Workbook: Free Worksheet
sum: Learn the difference between hearing and listening and eight ways people listen, then look closely at one recent conversation of your own.

title: What Does It Mean to Mean What You Say?
sum: To mean what you say, let your words match what you intend and will do. That is integrity and sincerity in everyday speech.

title: Is the Media Shaping What You Want?
sum: Is the media shaping what you want? Partly, because we learn which wants earn approval and chase them; noticing the borrowed ones lets you choose.
quote: Mass media conditions us as we learn to conform to get those things that we want.
img: the quote article's own signed image, its download JPEG (wp-content/uploads/quote-cards/og-quote--is-the-media-shaping-what-you-want--*.jpg)

title: The Stoic Challenge: Summary and Key Ideas
sum: William Irvine's Stoic reframe for meeting ordinary setbacks and genuine misfortune as tests you can pass, built from ancient philosophy and aimed at a modern reader chasing real, durable calm.

title: First Impressions and Snap Judgements Workbook
sum: Learn how fast first impressions form and how far they can be trusted, then test one of yours and choose what to do next.
